name: Python 3.12+ Clean Architecture Governance Pack
description: Standardized Python governance archetype enforcing Clean Architecture, single-responsibility 1-class-per-file layout, Google-style docstrings, strict static typing, and 100% test coverage across 5 domain patterns.

patterns.name: Decision List / Rules Engine
patterns.description: Ordered predicate evaluation yielding explicit decisions (Rule ABC + Engine dispatcher).

patterns.name: Repository-Service (CRUD / Query / Key-Value)
patterns.description: Direct lookup and persistence through abstract repository port (Repository ABC + Service).

patterns.name: Finite State Machine (FSM)
patterns.description: Deterministic lifecycle and state transitions with guards and event handlers.

patterns.name: Pipeline-Reducer / Streaming Transformation
patterns.description: Multi-stage sequential or reducing data transformation pipeline (PipelineStage ABC + Runner).

patterns.name: Algorithmic-Core / Optimization Solver
patterns.description: Isolated mathematical, heuristic, or algorithmic computation (Solver ABC / Strategy ABC).
